record.question: What is the process of heating the concentrated sulfide ore in excess air?
record.explanation: Answer B: Roasting. Roasting heats a concentrated sulfide ore in excess air/oxygen to convert sulfides to oxides and release sulfur dioxide. Reference: https://chem.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Inorganic_Chemistry/Supplemental_Modules_and_Websites_(Inorganic_Chemistry)/Descriptive_Chemistry/Elements_Organized_by_Block/2_p-Block_Elements/Group_16%3A_The_Oxygen_Family/Zinc%2C_Cadmium%2C_and_Mercury/Extraction_of_Zinc. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
